in_marathi.name: Bhoomi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Earth, ground, or land
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhoomi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Bhoomi is the goddess of the Earth, who is the wife of Vishnu and the mother of all beings. She is the source of all life and the giver of sustenance. Bhoomi is also known as Prithvi and is one of the primary deities in Hinduism.
